name: The Town
intro: Someone in the square greets you by name before you speak. You have not met them yet.
outro: The road out of town is signposted, which is the first honest thing all morning.

nodes.label: The Square
nodes.text: Stalls, a fountain, a shopkeeper who is already reaching for your usual.

nodes.label: The Errand
nodes.text: Nothing heroic. Move something, somewhere, on foot.

nodes.label: Say Something
nodes.text: To anyone. It does not have to be about anything.

nodes.label: The Long Way Round
nodes.text: You could go straight to the gate. You could also not.

nodes.label: The Town Gate
nodes.text: Beyond it the road narrows and the grass begins.
